entities.summary: Julius Olavus Middelthun was a Norwegian sculptor and educator. He is most associated with his busts and statues. Julius Middelthun was a painters & sculptors from Kongsberg (1820-07-03, Kongsberg–1886-05-05). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
